title: Future Tense in Hungarian – Quick Guide

sections.heading: How to talk about the future
paragraphs: In Hungarian, there are two main ways to express the future tense:
• Using the verb fog + the infinitive.
• Using the present tense when the future meaning is clear from context (e.g., with tomorrow, later, tonight).

sections.heading: Future tense with fog + infinitive
paragraphs: This is the most common and clearest way to express the future in Hungarian.

sections.heading: Using present tense for the future
paragraphs: You can use the present tense when the sentence clearly refers to a future event.
list: Holnap utazom Pestre. – I’m traveling to Budapest tomorrow.
Este találkozunk. – We’ll meet in the evening.

sections.heading: Negatives and questions
list: Negatives: Add nem before fog. Example: Én nem fogok enni. – I will not eat.
Questions: Use a question mark or rising intonation. Example: Fogsz jönni? – Will you come?

sections.heading: Quick Tips
list: You can often omit the subject (Én, Te, etc.) because the verb ending makes it clear.

sections.heading: More Examples
list: Holnap fogok futni. – I will run tomorrow.
Mi nem fogunk beszélni. – We won’t speak.
Ők fognak segíteni. – They will help.
